<script lang="ts">

        rotate: 0,
      },
      animate: {
        transformOrigin: 'bottom left',
        rotate: [0, 8, -8, 2, 0],

          times: [0, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1],

    path1: {},

        rotate: 0,

          duration: 0.6,
        },
      },
    },
    path3: {
      initial: {
        rotate: 0,
      },

        rotate: [0, 45, 0],
        transition: {
          ease: 'easeInOut',
          duration: 0.6,
          delay: 0.05,

      },
    },

defineOptions({ name: 'MessageCirclePlus', inheritAttrs: false })
